Review these L2 direction analysis diagnostics and decide how to handle each.

## Problem Description
Rylon Corporation manufactures Brute and Chanelle perfumes. The raw material needed to manufacture each type of perfume can be purchased for $3 per pound. Processing 1 lb of raw material requires 1 hour of laboratory time. Each pound of processed raw material yields 3 oz of Regular Brute Perfume and 4 oz of Regular Chanelle Perfume. Regular Brute can be sold for $7/oz and Regular Chanelle for $6/oz. Rylon also has the option of further processing Regular Brute and Regular Chanelle to produce Luxury Brute, sold at $18/oz, and Luxury Chanelle, sold at $14/oz. Each ounce of Regular Brute processed further requires an additional 3 hours of laboratory time and $4 processing cost and yields 1 oz of Luxury Brute. Each ounce of Regular Chanelle processed further requires an additional 2 hours of laboratory time and $4 processing cost and yields 1 oz of Luxury Chanelle. Each year, Rylon has 6,000 hours of laboratory time available and can purchase up to 4,000 lb of raw material. Formulate an LP that can be used to determine how Rylon can maximize profits. Assume that the cost of the laboratory hours is a fixed cost. Find the maximal profit.

## Current Code
```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Create model
m = gp.Model("Rylon_Perfume")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Extract parameters from data
raw_cost = data["raw_material_cost_per_lb"]
lab_hours_raw = data["lab_hours_per_lb_raw_material"]
yield_brute = data["regular_brute_yield_oz_per_lb"]
yield_chanelle = data["regular_chanelle_yield_oz_per_lb"]
price_reg_brute = data["regular_brute_price_per_oz"]
price_reg_chanelle = data["regular_chanelle_price_per_oz"]
price_lux_brute = data["luxury_brute_price_per_oz"]
price_lux_chanelle = data["luxury_chanelle_price_per_oz"]
hours_lux_brute = data["luxury_brute_additional_lab_hours_per_oz"]
hours_lux_chanelle = data["luxury_chanelle_additional_lab_hours_per_oz"]
cost_lux_brute = data["luxury_brute_additional_processing_cost_per_oz"]
cost_lux_chanelle = data["luxury_chanelle_additional_processing_cost_per_oz"]
total_lab_hours = data["annual_lab_hours_available"]
max_raw = data["max_raw_material_lb"]

# Decision variables (continuous - fractional values make sense for perfume)
x = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="raw_material_lb")
r_B = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="regular_brute_sold")
r_C = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="regular_chanelle_sold")
l_B = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="luxury_brute_produced")
l_C = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="luxury_chanelle_produced")

# Constraints
# 1. Raw material limit
m.addConstr(x <= max_raw, name="raw_material_limit")

# 2. Lab hours constraint
m.addConstr(lab_hours_raw * x + hours_lux_brute * l_B + hours_lux_chanelle * l_C <= total_lab_hours,
            name="lab_hours_limit")

# 3. Brute production balance (sold + processed <= produced)
m.addConstr(r_B + l_B <= yield_brute * x, name="brute_balance")

# 4. Chanelle production balance
m.addConstr(r_C + l_C <= yield_chanelle * x, name="chanelle_balance")

# Objective: Maximize profit
# Revenue - Raw material cost - Additional processing costs
profit = (price_reg_brute * r_B + price_reg_chanelle * r_C +
          price_lux_brute * l_B + price_lux_chanelle * l_C -
          raw_cost * x -
          cost_lux_brute * l_B - cost_lux_chanelle * l_C)

m.setObjective(profit, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

# Optimize
m.optimize()

# Output results
print(f"status: {m.Status}")
print(f"objective: {m.ObjVal}")

## Problem Description
Rylon Corporation manufactures Brute and Chanelle perfumes. The raw material needed to manufacture each type of perfume can be purchased for $3 per pound. Processing 1 lb of raw material requires 1 hour of laboratory time. Each pound of processed raw material yields 3 oz of Regular Brute Perfume and 4 oz of Regular Chanelle Perfume. Regular Brute can be sold for $7/oz and Regular Chanelle for $6/oz. Rylon also has the option of further processing Regular Brute and Regular Chanelle to produce Luxury Brute, sold at $18/oz, and Luxury Chanelle, sold at $14/oz. Each ounce of Regular Brute processed further requires an additional 3 hours of laboratory time and $4 processing cost and yields 1 oz of Luxury Brute. Each ounce of Regular Chanelle processed further requires an additional 2 hours of laboratory time and $4 processing cost and yields 1 oz of Luxury Chanelle. Each year, Rylon has 6,000 hours of laboratory time available and can purchase up to 4,000 lb of raw material. Formulate an LP that can be used to determine how Rylon can maximize profits. hours_lux_brute = data["luxury_brute_additional_lab_hours_per_oz"]
hours_lux_chanelle = data["luxury_chanelle_additional_lab_hours_per_oz"]
cost_lux_brute = data["luxury_brute_additional_processing_cost_per_oz"]
cost_lux_chanelle = data["luxury_chanelle_additional_processing_cost_per_oz"]
total_lab_hours = data["annual_lab_hours_available"]
max_raw = data["max_raw_material_lb"]

r_B = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="regular_brute_sold")
r_C = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="regular_chanelle_sold")
l_B = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="luxury_brute_produced")
l_C = m.addVar(lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="luxury_chanelle_produced")

# Constraints

m.addConstr(x <= max_raw, name="raw_material_limit")

            name="lab_hours_limit")

# 3. Brute production balance (sold + processed <= produced)

# 4. Chanelle production balance
m.addConstr(r_C + l_C <= yield_chanelle * x, name="chanelle_balance")

# Objective: Maximize profit

          raw_cost * x -

raw_radio = data["raw_material_cost_radio"]
price_tape = data["selling_price_tape_recorder"]
price_radio = data["selling_price_radio"]
